findings.description: F004 requires heuristic, unresolved, and filesystem graph items to remain visible with distinct styling and a legend, but F006's createJarvis journeys never assert those hooks in either producer state. A shell or router regression could strip the legend or classes while the narrower render test still passes.
findings.recommendation: Add real-shell assertions in the present and absent producer journeys for the evidence legend plus styling hooks and survival of heuristic_import, unresolved heuristic_target, and fs_* graph items.

findings.description: F003 pins the row-level C0 baseline story, but F006 only asserts that a baseline coverage panel exists. It does not require the real shell path to prove per-language status, all 10 evidence-type rows including reserved runtime, scan-truncation behavior, or notes rendered verbatim for the producer states.
findings.recommendation: Extend the real-shell journeys or add a parameterized createJarvis journey to assert the full baseline panel contents from producer-regenerated present and absent payloads, including truncated and unrecognized-language cases.

findings.description: F002 requires safe fallback rendering for the reserved DIFF_TAXONOMY values, but the producer currently emits only the three live values and the no-ADR branch emits no diff entries. F006's no-ADR journey therefore cannot actually exercise fallback badge behavior.
findings.recommendation: Pin fallback badge behavior with an explicit renderer matrix over all DIFF_TAXONOMY values, or revise F006 so fallback coverage is tested outside producer-generated journey fixtures.
